method: Mirror image across vertical line (left-right flip)
steps: Mirror MN is vertical on the right, so left-right is reversed, top-bottom kept
Black rectangle moves to top-right, circle to top-left, triangle points right
Cube box moves to bottom-right, tall rectangle to bottom-left
Top-left square with diamond: 4 corner triangles + 1 inside the diamond cut by the inner square = 5
V shape on top edge split by a vertical line: 3
Middle-right: diagonal with vertical left edge and with right edge: 2
Bottom row zigzag: 2 halves + combined + right corner + inverted-V on the base = 5
Vertical mirror on the right reverses left-right order: 2 K g r m 4 order
Each character laterally inverted, none upside down
Option C shows all characters reversed left-right and upright

steps: Tame is the opposite of Wild

Q x R: R is sister of Q
R - S: S is mother of R (and Q)
S / T: S is daughter of T
Q is daughter of S, S daughter of T: Q is T's daughter's daughter
